name: request_enquiry_acknowledgement
description: Ask whether the enquirer wants a separate acknowledgement. If declined use requested=false. Otherwise ask for channel and recipient, call with confirmed=false, read back the result, wait for yes, then call with the same recipient/channel and confirmed=true. This is separate from notifying the business owner. Never claim a queued message was received.

name: request_conversation_copy
description: Request a copy after this voice conversation is saved. First capture_lead with the caller's contact and permission. Read back that recipient, whether they want saved text or the recording link, and SMS or email. Call with confirmed=true only after their clear yes. A requested or queued response never means sent.

name: capture_lead
description: Save a visitor's contact details and what they want so the business can follow up. Only call this after the visitor has given a phone number or email.

message.description: What they want: product, quantity, question, or follow-up action

consent_to_contact.description: True only if the visitor agreed to be texted or emailed by the business

consent_to_marketing.description: True only if the visitor explicitly said yes when asked whether they also want offers and promotions. Never assume it, and never set it just because they gave contact details.

name: get_booking_link
description: Get the link where the visitor can book an appointment.

name: check_availability
description: List free appointment times for one date (business local time). Never offer a time that this tool did not return.

name: book_appointment
description: Book an appointment. The first call returns a read-back sentence: read it to the visitor and wait for a clear yes, then call again with the same start and name and confirmed=true.

consent_to_contact.description: True only if the visitor agreed to reminders by text or email

confirmed.description: True only after the visitor said yes to the read-back

name: search_knowledge
description: Search the business's website content. Call this before answering any question about the business, its products, services, prices, hours or policies.
